name: Vocality Health
long_description:
Our app allows doctors to speak any language, eliminating the need for human medical translators in hospitals and clinics. Despite spending billions on in-person and remote translators—mostly through outdated call centers—hospitals still fail to provide adequate care for non-English-speaking patients.

We're building the most accurate and compliant medical language translation system across voice and video modalities.

launches.title: Vocality Health: AI-powered medical interpretation for hospitals
launches.tagline: Your AI powered medical interpreter, breaking language barriers in healthcare
launches.body:
Hey everyone [👋](https://emojipedia.org/waving-hand)\
We’re [Brogan](https://www.linkedin.com/in/brogan-mcpartland-05830031a/) and [Vivek](https://www.linkedin.com/in/vivek-jayaram/), the cofounders of [Vocality Health](https://www.vocalityhealth.com).

**TL;DR**: Hospitals spend billions on medical language interpretation services every year. Despite the cost, patients still face language barriers in healthcare. Vocality Health is building the most accurate and secure AI medical language interpretation system. Unlike human interpreters, Vocality is instant, always available, and integrates directly into hospital workflows. Hospitals are already signing up.\
\
<https://youtu.be/_-uy7y-sCBY>

---

## The Problem ❌

Hospitals struggle to communicate with linguistically diverse patients. Current solutions like human interpreters, phone services, or ad hoc translation by family members are slow, expensive, and often unavailable when needed most. Miscommunication leads to worse outcomes, longer hospital stays, and nearly doubles the cost of care.

---

## Our Solution ✅

Vocality Health is an AI-powered interpretation platform for hospitals that provides real-time, accurate, and clinically safe translation for doctors and patients.

Unlike existing services:

* **🏥 Instant & Always On** – No need to wait for an interpreter.
* **🧑‍⚕️ Built for Hospitals** – Designed for clinical use, not general-purpose translation. Compliant and built to preserve patient privacy.
* **📲 Fully Integrated** – Works with existing systems and hospital workflows.

Hospitals using Vocality get faster patient care, lower costs, and better outcomes.

---

## The Team 🤝

Vivek and I met as undergrads on the Harvard Cricket Club and later built [Fulltrack AI](https://www.linkedin.com/company/fulltrack-ai), a viral cricket app that became the #1 sports app in India, outranking the Olympics app (during the Olympics).

We’re now teaming up again to solve a problem that is deeply personal to both of us. After being denied coverage in the U.S., I spent years navigating international healthcare, experiencing firsthand how language barriers impact care and outcomes. Vivek, a PhD in speech generative models, has spent years developing AI to improve real-time communication. This problem is at the intersection of our experiences and expertise, and we couldn’t be more excited to be tackling it.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=88135&key=user_uploads/467701/8b9289f5-6fd0-428c-9709-049edb562379)

---

## 🚀 Early Traction

🏥 **Hospitals are already signing up to use Vocality Health.** Even at this early stage, they see the value and are willing to pay today.

If you're a hospital, provider, or industry expert, we’d love to chat.

📩 Get in touch at [founders@vocalityhealth.com](mailto:founders@vocalityhealth.com)\
🌍 Learn more: <https://www.vocalityhealth.com>

Let’s make healthcare truly accessible.
